home.kicker: A youth initiative for a real mark
home.title: We make a purpose
home.lead: Each of us has something to give: knowledge, a skill, time, effort, or even a kind word. Together, the small things become something much bigger.
home.hello: Welcome to ATHAR — a place where we learn, help, and make a real difference together.
home.storyP1: ATHAR is a youth initiative with a simple aim and a large meaning: to learn, to help, and to leave a real mark on people's lives.
home.storyP2: Online, we open chances to learn, build skills, practice languages, and support students. On the ground, we step into people's lives through services, volunteering, and community work.
home.storyP3: We don't want to pass through unnoticed. We want to leave a mark.

verbs.note: A skill, a language, a first step
Time and effort that reach someone

home.pathsLead: Open a path and see the different spaces inside the initiative.
home.onlineSub: A path for learning, skills, languages, and study support across the Arab world.
onlinePoints: Learning support for people with disabilities
home.offlineSub: Field work across Egypt, close to people's everyday lives.
offlinePoints: Help for people and families who need it
home.valuesLead: ATHAR brings together young people from across Egypt who believe change is not one person's job. We are not chasing the biggest membership list. We are building a real community, where every person has a voice, an idea, and room to learn, try, lead, and leave a mark.

values.title: We believe in potential
values.body: We are not only looking for experience. We are looking for the courage to begin.

values.title: We open the room
values.body: Every voice, idea, and skill has a place, even on the first step.

values.title: We leave something behind
values.body: Experience, relationships, skills, and a mark we are proud of.

volunteer.kicker: A chance to leave a real mark
volunteer.title: Join the
volunteer.lead: Volunteering with us is not a pile of tasks. It is room to learn, gain experience, and do something good for someone else.

offline.title: On the ground
offline.subtitle: Real service, in real places
offline.intro: You do not have to change the whole world. Start by changing one person's day. The offline team turns intention into practical help.
offline.why: You learn teamwork and responsibility, meet different people, and leave something you can see. Previous experience is not required. What matters is the will to show up.
points: Help for people and families who need it

online.title: Online education
online.subtitle: Let your skill become someone else's chance
online.intro: If you have a skill, or you love teaching, you can help someone learn, grow, and move closer to a goal. This includes support for thanaweya amma and baccalaureate students.
online.why: You do not need to have taught before. You need to be responsible, committed, and ready to learn. If you choose STEM on the leaders form, tell HR.

volunteer.ageStudentsNote: for students learning on the platform.
volunteer.stemBody: The new branch lives inside online education. If you feel ready, apply through the leaders form and tell HR you chose STEM.
volunteer.branchesBody: After you are accepted, check your email and join your governorate group in the ATHAR community to reach the branch leader.
volunteer.formsLead: Open the link for your current role. What is open can change as the teams need more people.

volunteer.peopleLead: When you send a question, say what you need and reach the person responsible, so nothing gets lost.
volunteer.faqLead: A clear answer helps you start with a steadier step.

faq.q: Do I have to be free all the time?
faq.a: No. Volunteering needs honest time management and a clear commitment, not a completely empty calendar.
It grows character, leadership, and communication, and builds real relationships and experience alongside serving others.

Certificates are given at the volunteer celebration at the end of the season. Students receive theirs after the course. There are exceptions for cases that need one after the volunteering period is complete.
Check your email for the reply, then join your governorate group in the ATHAR community.

faq.q: I was accepted online. What now?
faq.a: Contact an HR member using the details in the email to set an interview time.
